data.raw_text:
[5:53PM] #AjegunleApapa #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement from Otto Wharf towards Ajeromi is proceeding at a rapid pace. Similarly, the route from Ojo Road through Okoya to Ajeromi is experiencing fast-moving traffic. At the Ajeromi intersection, all commercial buses are currently being diverted to Ojora Street as an alternative route to connect with the Boundary Bus Stop.

 The stretch from Baale to the Boundary Roundabout is also characterized by fast-moving traffic.
Furthermore, the Mobil Road axis, both towards Marine Beach and on the return journey to Ajegunle, is currently reporting good traffic flow. The Ijora Oloopa/High Bridge route, extending through Total and up to Danlami, is experiencing fast-moving traffic in both lanes.

 However, it is noted that while one lane from Danlami towards Area B is clear and moving well, the second lane is currently occupied by flatbed trucks. Lastly, the movement of vehicles exiting Apapa via the Marine Bridge is also proceeding at a fast pace. 

No traffic impediments have been reported during this period, and our officers remain on site to ensure the continued smooth flow of traffic.

#FollowLASTMA
